note: The commit every kernel here is proved against. scripts/bend-checkout.mjs fetches it from upstream by sha, then from the public mirror by tag (a fork of upstream that keeps every pin under a pin-<sha7> tag, because upstream has force-pushed before and a sha can vanish there), then from BEND_MIRROR (a git URL, with BEND_MIRROR_TAG) when set, which is tried first; spec/build-kernel.ts and spec/laws-check.ts refuse a checkout at any other commit. The pin moves with upstream: the bend-upstream workflow reports when upstream's head still proves every law and regenerates the kernels, and an advance is one pull request that sets this sha and version, regenerates the kernels, and pushes the new pin-<sha7> tag to the mirror.
